recommendation_summary: The reply recommends replacing the endpoint's fetch-all-rows-and-count-in-memory logic with a Postgres SELECT COUNT(*) on an indexed unpaid status. It recommends shipping no Kafka topics, projection services or Redis this week. There are no optional additions. It does not mention verifying latency or checking that the new count matches the old one.
note: The fix is the bounded in-database aggregate and keeps request-time semantics, but none of the four required labels appear, so every record predicate fails.
